A '''sensor mesh''' was a device created by [[Tavia Kitik]] and designed to detect and steal data from [[Keycard/Legends|keycards]]. [[Bink Kitik]], Tavia's twin sister, wore a sensor mesh under her dress to steal information from businessman [[Cristoff]]'s keycard in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]
